provenance.source: Local recorded test gameplay; no multiplayer chat or account files exported.
provenance.images: Real model-input frames, masked top 64px and bottom 26%, resized to 320x180; no image metadata.
provenance.state: Allowlisted fields only; absolute positions translated by a shared integer origin; names, paths, session IDs, wall-clock timestamps, chat and prompts omitted.
provenance.pairing: Legacy episodes did not retain exact post-ack frames. Recorded cases pair consecutive model-input frames with their matching game_before state. These are not claimed to reproduce historical feedback byte for byte.
provenance.expectations: Frozen once during fixture preparation and inspected; tests never regenerate expected results.
provenance.authored_cases: Safety mutations, screen cycle and final stationary extension are explicitly labeled, not represented as observed model behavior.
provenance.exact_result_pair: One additional vanilla 1.20.1 record retains its exact acknowledged result image. post_ack_delay_ms is relative, with no wall-clock timestamp.
